_doc: Registry of specialized fused-GDN-decode kernel integrations.  This
file IS the dispatch surface: it is consulted on every call and there
is no environment variable that turns it off.  Each row is one
complete gdn_fused_decode_step call signature served by one kernel
implementation; 'impl' names the module that serves it, next to this
file at kernel/gdn_fused_decode_<impl>.py.  A signature may appear
once per capable impl (this op ships two: a two-launch CuTe-DSL
kernel and a single-launch persistent CUDA kernel), and dispatch
prefers cute_dsl, then cuda, then the composable reference -- those
family names are internal, the op takes no backend argument.  New
kernels add impl modules and rows here; the dispatch code does not
change.
Signature fields: cc (SM as major*10+minor), b/hidden/n_ba/qkv_dim/
h_q/hv/d/conv_width/conv_state_len (exact sizes), conv_layout (the
physical conv-state pool layout: 'SD' = (state_len, dim) rows passed
as their transposed view -- the vLLM default -- or 'DS' = dense
(dim, state_len) rows).  Dtypes and stride patterns are fixed by the
op contract and checked by the dispatch guard, not per row.  Full
schema and the impl-module interface: README.md next to this file.
Shipped surface: decode batches 1/2/4/8 of the Qwen3.5-27B layer
geometry on SM120, per impl.  Larger batches are deliberately absent
-- the kernel is faster there in isolation, but the end-to-end
serving measurement did not reproduce a win, and a row is a promise
about end-to-end behaviour, not about the kernel alone.
